sources.measurement_method: Transform 10 unique outer-ring points with the project local lon/lat approximation into campus coordinates; OSM ring bounds match the original manifest massing bounds to better than 0.0001 m in each XY extent.
sources.uncertainty: Community-mapped geometry; not a cadastral or architectural survey. Footprint outline is used for wall/base shell, not roof overhang.

sources.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office, Indiana Building Footprints 2016-2020 FeatureServer layer 0
sources.source_crs: Service returns geometry as WGS84; layer spatial reference is Web Mercator EPSG:3857
sources.measurement_method: Returned polygon ring is projected with the project local approximation for comparison. At 209.76 m² it is larger than the 159.48 m² OSM wall outline and visually follows the orthophoto roof envelope; model uses the ring as an approximate roof-plan infill/extent, not as a surveyed wall outline.
sources.uncertainty: LiDAR-derived roof envelope, not ground-level foundation survey; no height model used.

sources.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office, Indiana Current Orthophotography ImageServer
sources.feature_id: ImageServer export at the Cottage coordinate
sources.source_date: Service coverage 2022-2025; exact local capture date unavailable
sources.source_crs: Request/export extent WGS84 EPSG:4326; source service uses Web Mercator
sources.measurement_method: Export 1200x700 crop at recorded WGS84 extent; compare roof outline visually against OSM and Indiana LiDAR polygons. Used for orientation, roof plan and neighborhood-side context only.
sources.uncertainty: No exact image date/camera, orthophoto does not provide elevations or facade details.
